entities.name: Aristotle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Greek philosopher (384–322 BCE), student of Plato and tutor of Alexander the Great. His works on logic, metaphysics, ethics, politics, and natural science dominated Western thought for nearly two millennia and profoundly influenced Islamic and Christian scholarship.
